metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to relieve sciatica pain in both legs, at home, using NO SPECIAL EQUIPMENT!

If you're dealing with bilateral sciatica pain (on both sides) and need a quick fix, here's a set of SAFE and effective sciatic nerve pain relief stretches and exercises that can give quick relief in as little as 30 SECONDS!

They are going to be shown in different positions (such as standing or seated), and focus on relieving tension and pressure off the sciatic nerve and spinal discs of the lower back (lumbar spine).

WATCH NOW and quickly get rid of sciatica pain in both legs!
